bid.title: Hiring of Agency for IT Projects- Milestone basis
bid.buyer: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
bid.reason: The tender is explicitly for a 'Fingerprint based Biometric Authentication solution', which is a physical identity verification system, not Anti-Money Laundering (AML) software for transaction monitoring or sanctions screening.

evidence.quote: Bank intends to on-board vendor for Supply, Installation, Commission and Maintenance of Fingerprint based Biometric Authentication solution for a period of 5 years
Bank reserves the right to modify the scope due to change in regulatory instructions... with regard to the proposed Biometric Authentication solution

bid.title: Hiring of Agency for IT Projects- Milestone basis
bid.buyer: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
bid.buyer_org: National Bank For Agriculture And Ruraldevelopment
bid.reason: The tender explicitly requests an Enterprise KYC, KYB, CKYC & AML Solution with specific requirements for AML transaction monitoring and screening.

evidence.quote: NABARD seeks an Enterprise KYC, KYB, CKYC & AML Solution for development, implementation, integration and roll-out across NABARD applications and systems.
The transaction monitoring system shall support rule-based, threshold-based, and behavioral pattern detection with alert generation and integration into AML case management workflows.
The Bidder should have experience in the development, implementation and management of KYC, CKYC and AML solutions... for the same or different eligible financial institutions

key_facts.scope_summary: Development and implementation of an Enterprise KYC, KYB, CKYC & AML Solution including transaction monitoring and screening.
